description: This file defines the EmployeeSubordinateModel class, which models an employee's subordinate information along with reporting method details within the OrangeHRM system. It implements serialization features and is part of the API layer for HR data access.

classes.name: EmployeeSubordinateModel
classes.description: A model class for representing an employee subordinate and reporting method data in the HR management API.
